correctness.rationale: The three-site proof exhausts all possible center-containing consecutive pooling blocks, proves each Jacobian maps every input step to an output with variation at most one, then integrates the piecewise-affine derivative. Strictly separated monotone data realize equality for each N>=4. The five-site 10-vector pair has exact rational KKT witnesses for 12 local proximal problems, with positive minimum strict slack 3/20; the output difference (0,1/3,0,1,2/3,1)/1000 and ratio 7/3 follow exactly. Scaling and right extension preserve the lower bound for arbitrary lambda>0 and N>=10. No five-site global upper sharpness is asserted.

value.rationale: Local TV fitting is an established denoising construction, yet spatial-window width controls whether TV distance between perturbed signals is preserved. The result gives a complete width-three nonexpansivity theorem and a substantive exact five-window amplification (7/3) rather than a routine numerical example. This distinction is important in choosing locality for robust nonlinear signal processing. Sharp global coefficient for width five is explicitly left open.
